csv_scope_of_work: The Department of Public Works for the City of Manchester, NH (DPW) is soliciting proposals from qualified consultants or consultant teams to provide on-call design and engineering services related to planning, design, and construction phases of transportation projects. The selected consultant will be responsible for delivering comprehensive highway design services, including but not limited to preliminary engineering, environmental coordination, geometric design, pavement design, drainage and stormwater management, traffic analysis, utility coordination, right-of-way support, preparation of plans, specifications, and cost estimates (PS&E), and construction support services.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Sanitation Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering

title: Transportation Design and Engineering Services
short_description: On-call transportation design services for highway and related municipal infrastructure projects in Manchester.
project_scope: On-call consulting services for transportation projects covering planning, design, and construction phases. Scope includes preliminary engineering, environmental coordination, geometric highway design, pavement design, drainage and stormwater management, traffic analysis, utility coordination, right-of-way support, preparation of plans, specifications and estimates (PS&E), and construction support. No specific individual structure, span, or building size is defined; up to three contracts may be awarded for a 60-month term.
services: On-call transportation design and engineering services including civil engineering, structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, sanitation engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call services for multiple unspecified transportation projects.
- Primarily highway and municipal infrastructure design, not a defined bridge or special structure.
- Includes structural engineering, but no concrete bridge, long-span, or architecturally demanding scope is identified.
- Also includes several disciplines outside sbp's core focus such as traffic, surveying, geotechnics, and general civil works.
- Price/award structure and technical ambition are not described, limiting strategic relevance.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is for on-call design services for multiple future transportation projects over a 60-month period, so no realistic single construction cost can be derived from the provided information.
fee_explanation: No fee or estimated contract value is stated. Up to three on-call contracts may be awarded for a 60-month term, but the documents provided here contain no upset limit, hourly schedule, or total consultant budget.
references_qualifications: Qualified consultants or consultant teams are requested. Disciplines sought include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, sanitation engineering, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or project-type qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
